Recon_NetworkScan.description: Network/port scanning to discover ICS assets (nmap sweep for Modbus port 502)

Recon_DeviceID.description: Modbus Read Device Identification (FC 0x2B/0x0E) to fingerprint PLCs

Recon_FCScan.description: Function code scanning (FC 1-127) to fingerprint supported PLC capabilities

FDI.description: False Data Injection — writing falsified sensor/measurement values to holding registers

NaiveResponseInjection.description: Naive response injection — constant, clearly out-of-range values to registers

CmdInjectCoil.description: Command injection via coil writes (FC05/FC15) — toggling actuators/breakers/relays

CmdInjectRegister.description: Command injection via register writes (FC06/FC16) — modifying control setpoints

MaliciousFC.description: Malicious function codes (FC07/FC08) — diagnostics restart, exception status leak, counter clear

DoS.description: Modbus request flood — raw-socket fire-and-forget Modbus read requests

DoS_ConnExhaust.description: TCP connection exhaustion — opening max connections without closing them

Replay.description: Scapy-based packet replay — capture then retransmit legitimate Modbus frames

MITM.description: Transparent TCP proxy — intercepts and modifies Modbus FC03 responses in transit
